line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

verification.scope: Fresh baseline hash, filtered source difference and logical line check; prior compiler controls cited in decision. No production change or new runtime test.

decision: Final hash matches the complete S6 P4 source audit. Checked live opennt_user_multipass.h and layout consumers: the header is deliberately re-entered for distinct declaration groups. Original private PTDB/PWND/PTHREADINFO aliases conflict with guest or native binding types (C2371); original winerrp.h requests a missing UserSetLastError at link. COLOR_MAX is supplied by some drawing builds, but P241 original controls report C2065 in four contexts. Member extent uses original COLOR_INFOBK+1; PJIF spelling expands to the original DWORD pointer. Once guards avoid redeclarations across real inclusion phases. Retain existing residuals; no extra compatibility types or branches.
